description: Disponibilité temps réel des parkings MEL is a dataset listed in Roubaix Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Métropole Européenne de Lille. Disponibilité des parkings métropolitains en temps réel. Fréquence de rafraîchissement: 5 minutes Mise en garde: Les données de certains parkings restent en cours d'acquisition. Coverage: Roubaix. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Parking, Temps réel, disponibilité. The portal shows 6 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roubaix-fr-portal.
